batch.description: Jahangirnagar University H Unit, academic session 2020-2021, Set-A — full 60-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of Part 2 of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.238-244 (printed pp.53-59 of Part 2). Header (book PDF p.238): জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০২০-২০২১ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৬০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-A, সময়: ৪০ মিনিট; page banner 'প্রশ্ন ও সমাধান: ২০২০-২১'. Part 2 has NO answer table: each question carries its key inline, as an '[Ans: x]' tag and/or a printed worked solution ('সমাধান:'/'Solution:'); the two forms never both occur for the same question in this paper, so no tag-vs-solution disagreement arises. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The paper is printed in two syllabus tiers whose question numbers interlock: the 'Short Syllabus' run (banner on book PDF p.238) carries 43 questions and the 'Extra Syllabus' block (heading on book PDF p.243, continuing on p.244) carries the remaining 17 (Q21, 26, 27, 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 44, 45, 51, 52, 55, 56, 57, 59, 60); together they partition the printed numbers 1-60 exactly once, and each question's tier is recorded in its topic field. The book prints no per-subject headings; subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-5, English Q6-15, Physics Q16-30, Higher Mathematics Q31-60 — counts Bangla 5, English 10, Physics 15, Higher Mathematics 30. Page map (book PDF): p.238 carries Q1-14; p.239 carries Q15-20, 22-24; p.240 carries Q25, 28-34; p.241 carries Q35, 36, 42, 43, 46-48; p.242 carries Q49, 50, 53, 54, 58; p.243 (Extra Syllabus) carries Q21, 26, 27, 37-41, 44; p.244 (Extra Syllabus, continued) carries Q45, 51, 52, 55-57, 59, 60. Keys: 58 keyed single_choice, 0 dual keys, 0 keyless, and exactly TWO printed no-correct-option dispositions — Q45 (Extra Syllabus, solution headed 'সমাধান: (সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'; the solution derives x < 1/3, which is not among the options) and Q51 (Extra Syllabus, solution key slot literally printed '(blank)' and the solution computing the smallest angle as 30°, which is not among the options, closing '∴ সঠিক উত্তর option এ নেই।'); those two carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim, not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. Two questions carry figures: Q29 (the four options are E_k vs f graphs) and Q52 (cyclic-quadrilateral diagram in the stem); diagrams appearing only inside printed worked solutions (Q16, Q29 solution sketch, Q50, Q52 solution copy, Q53, Q54, Q58) do not make their questions figure questions. Preserved print anomalies: Q6(a) prints 'promissuous' and Q12(b) prints 'delibaretion' (the misspellings are the questions' subject matter); Q19(c) prints G as 6.675 × 10^-13 Nm^2kg^-2; Q25(c)/(d) refer to 'a ও b' although the appliances are unlettered in the stem; Q27's stem prints 'উভবতল'; Q30's stem prints 'ভূমি প্রবাহ' for the base current; Q43's options print a double ±; Q49(c) prints '45° ও 50°'; Q53 options (b) and (d) both print '30 বর্গ একক' identically; Q55's lettered options all print '≥' for the first inequality although the stem says অনধিক, and the solution keys (d); Q56's stem asks 'নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?' twice and its statement (i) prints '+ k̂' although the point's z-coordinate is 0. BOUNDARY NOTE: book PDF p.245 (printed p.60) is NOT part of this paper — it opens the next paper, JU H Unit 2019-2020 Set-E — and nothing from p.245 onward is included here. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. The book's Part 2 (typeset প্রশ্ন-সমাধান section) restarts pagination: printed page = book PDF page - 185. Set-A of JU H Unit 2020-2021 occupies printed pp.53-59 = book PDF pp.238-244: 'Short Syllabus' run on pp.238-242 (banner on p.238) and the 'Extra Syllabus' block beginning on printed p.58 (book PDF p.243) and continuing on printed p.59 (book PDF p.244). The following paper, JU H Unit 2019-2020 Set-E, begins on printed p.60 (book PDF p.245). There is no answer table in Part 2; keys are inline ('[Ans: x]' tags and printed 'সমাধান:'/'Solution:' worked solutions printed directly under each question). Paper header (book PDF p.238) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০২০-২০২১ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৬০, ইউনিট-H, সেট-A, সময়: ৪০ মিনিট. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image at 300 dpi, with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at ~200%) for Q1-Q6, Q19-Q29, Q30-Q36, Q37-Q44, Q42-Q43, Q45-Q52 and Q55-Q60. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →).
